brief.secret_value: The value isn't included here on purpose. Treat it as compromised: it's in the repository.
brief.kev: Known to be exploited (in the CISA KEV catalog since {{date}})
brief.kev_ransomware: Known to be exploited, including in ransomware campaigns (in the CISA KEV catalog since {{date}})
brief.verify_code: the fix is merged. The next scan of the repository confirms it and comments here.
brief.verify_dependency: the update is merged, lockfile included. The next scan confirms the new version and comments here.
brief.verify_no_fix: you update to a fixed version once one is published; the next scan confirms it and comments here. Until then, record the mitigation or the accepted risk in Pitangus.
brief.verify_image: the rebuilt image is published. Its next scan confirms it and comments here.
brief.verify_secret: the provider confirms the old credential no longer works. A scan can only confirm it left the code.
brief.verify_web: a new scan of the domain (or a newly imported report) no longer finds it. Pitangus then comments here.

action.image: Update {{package}} from {{version}} to {{target}} in the image and rebuild it.
action.no_fix: {{package}} {{version}} has no fixed version yet: check whether your code uses the affected part. If it does, mitigate it; if not, record the accepted risk.
action.secret: Revoke this credential with its provider, then remove it from the code.
